question: How do the population and residual marker outcomes align across the evidence panels?
decision: Support direct comparison of already measured endpoints and identify where results disagree.
strongest_rival: Bulk expression reflects distinct mixtures or lower identity marker expression within shared populations.
discriminator: Examine published marker combinations against the separately measured bulk directions; joint per-cell expression remains unmeasured.
exposure_record: All underlying results were viewed before freezing this display. No new effect estimation.
biological_unit: The deposited library is the description unit; donor preparation and recipient or pool crosswalks are unresolved.
nesting_and_overlap: Do not pair replicate labels. Tables and deposits share their original source and do not constitute independent replication.
population_and_selection: Public per-library quantifications and author tables. The transfer and AM assays describe selected recovered cells.
contrast: Display existing author flow panels, WT minus KO or factor minus empty RNA contrasts, and called BED overlaps.
endpoint: Existing published flow measurements, published fold changes, combined BED overlaps and deposited RNA marker TPM.
methods: Render prior author fold changes and combined peak counts, and assemble the published PNG/JPEG source panels with the verified lung RNA heatmap.
missingness_and_exclusions: Show the missing author Hp contrast and zero peak overlaps as distinct states.
multiplicity: Descriptive comparisons only, no new P values. Retain author adjusted P values and apply planned signature thresholds.
precision_basis: Observed library values and omission sensitivity are descriptive; unresolved source nesting prevents a precision claim.
interpretation_limit: No causal pathway, lineage or cell-level inference. Peak overlap is limited to the chosen feature; no antibody-pair effect estimate.
stop_rule: Hold model-based inference if biological unit mapping is unresolved; require all declared libraries and valid checksums.
amendment_reason: Initial descriptive reconstruction on public processed and author-reported inputs.
